name: cmb2
title: CMB2
description: CMB2 is a developer's toolkit for building metaboxes, custom fields, and forms for WordPress that will blow your mind.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: npm run build:css:compile && npm run build:css:rtl && npm run build:css:banner && npm run build:css:minify
scripts.build:css:rtl: rtlcss css/cmb2.css css/cmb2-rtl.css && rtlcss css/cmb2-front.css css/cmb2-front-rtl.css && rtlcss css/cmb2-display.css css/cmb2-display-rtl.css
scripts.build:js: npm run build:js:lint && npm run build:js:minify
scripts.build:i18n: npm run build:i18n:pot && npm run build:i18n:mo
scripts.build:i18n:pot: wp-pot --src '**/*.php' --dest-file languages/cmb2.pot --domain cmb2 --package CMB2 --bug-report 'http://wordpress.org/support/plugin/cmb2' --last-translator 'CMB2 Team hello@cmb2.io' --team 'CMB2 Team hello@cmb2.io'
scripts.build:i18n:mo: for f in languages/*.po; do msgfmt -o "${f%.po}.mo" "$f"; done
